slices.label: Slice 2 · Baselines and temporal design
slices.deliverable: Establish last-state, personal mean, MA5, EWMA, logistic/linear and quantile baselines; use rolling development inside 2025 and evaluate on 2026
slices.verification: All features shifted before target appearance; 2026 EWMA5 RMSE 0.6729 versus last-state 0.8421; lagged logistic AP 0.2047/Brier 0.0609/log loss 0.2390 versus prevalence AP 0.0698/Brier 0.0656/log loss 0.2596; 2026 status later amended by Slice 3A

slices.label: Slice 3A · Calendar-gap and persistence repair
slices.deliverable: Replace four-day rest filling with actual pitcher-role calendar gaps, enforce explicit long-gap reset behavior, expand phi through zero, correct half-life units and freeze amended 2026 evaluation semantics
slices.verification: 2025-only policy search rebuilt v1.1 artifacts; 2026 Stuff RMSE gain SP 13.80%/RP 11.57%, Command +1.87%/+0.40% exploratory, Result 0%; 243 SP and 456 RP returning histories have complete actual cross-season gaps and no four-day fill; 8 targeted tests passed

slices.label: Slice 4 · Markov regime switching
slices.deliverable: Estimate role-specific filtered regime probabilities with 2–5 state comparison, calendar-dependent transitions, 60-day stationary resets and deterministic post-fit labels
slices.verification: 2025-only fit/validation selected SP 2 states (Stable/Collapse) and RP 3 (Stable/Collapse/High-volatility); all candidates cleared 2% occupancy, but 4–5 state held-out likelihood failed; bootstrap median emission similarity SP 0.721/RP 0.693 and transition similarity 0.979/0.870; 2026 collapse AP 0.102/0.098; no unsupported Declining/Recovering labels forced

slices.label: Slice 5 · GAS volatility with multi-horizon load
slices.deliverable: Fit role-specific Student-t score-driven variance with lagged HAR 1/5/15-appearance, workload and calendar-gap correction using 2025-only Duan smearing
slices.verification: 2026 GAS+HAR NLL per row SP 1.6044/RP 1.6089 versus EWMA 1.6067/1.6150; QLIKE SP 1.3935/RP 1.4477 versus EWMA 1.3992/1.4555; 80%/95% coverage SP 81.1%/95.6%, RP 81.2%/95.6%; squared-standardized residual lag-1 autocorrelation 0.041/0.045; gains are small and research-only

slices.label: Slice 6 · GJR-GARCH challenger
slices.deliverable: Fit pooled-by-role Student-t GJR-GARCH with explicit pitcher-role and long-gap resets, constrained stationarity and no under-supported per-pitcher fits
slices.verification: Both roles converged with persistence SP 0.991/RP 0.987; negative-shock gamma estimated at 0 for both, so asymmetry is not supported; 2026 GJR NLL 1.6059/1.6130 did not beat GAS+HAR; 11 targeted Performance State/WPA tests passed

slices.label: Slice 7 · POT-EVT tail risk
slices.deliverable: Fit role-specific peaks-over-threshold generalized Pareto tails to GAS+HAR-standardized negative Stuff innovations; expose extreme-event probability and supported expected severity with SAV/asymmetric-slope CAViaR comparison
slices.verification: 2025-only censored-likelihood threshold/declustering selection chose SP q95/run0 (236 clusters, xi 0.023, bootstrap CI -0.088 to 0.129, KS p 0.926) and RP q95/run0 (758 clusters, xi 0.343, CI 0.276 to 0.446, KS p 0.390); 2026 EVT AP SP 0.076/RP 0.101 with about 20% recall at 8.6–9.8% alerts; asymmetric CAViaR selected for both, SP 95% violation 5.09% passes Kupiec p 0.785 while RP 5.74% fails p 0.000031; 13 targeted tests passed

slices.label: Slice 8 · Collapse and rebound forecasts
slices.deliverable: Combine frozen latent-state forecasts, regime priors, conditional volatility and EVT tail features into separately calibrated role-specific forecasts for process collapse, result collapse, return-to-baseline and strong rebound
slices.verification: 2025 chronological 60/20/20 train-calibration-validation completed for 8 role-target models; five cumulative logistic ablations plus XGBoost challenger, calibration curves, fixed-negative-tail alert thresholds and feature importance persisted; filtered/current-appearance states are prohibited by test

slices.label: Slice 9 · External-diagnostic and prospective gates

slices.verification: 2026 process-collapse AP SP 0.185 vs 0.100 baseline and RP 0.183 vs 0.065 both pass AP/Brier/log-loss gates; SP result-collapse also passes narrowly, RP return-to-baseline passes, while SP return-to-baseline, both strong-rebound models and RP result-collapse fail. slices.deliverable: Build independent versioned appearance warehouses for 2023–2026 with a common 2023 leverage reference and unchanged role/game keys
slices.verification: 20,629/20,693/20,868/20,793 unique appearance rows for 2023/2024/2025/2026; Plus and result coverage are effectively 100%; every pitcher-role-game key is unique. Historical Plus values use the current frozen retrospective models, and no v1 artifact was overwritten

slices.label: Slice 13 · Expanding-window validation
slices.deliverable: Evaluate strictly forward folds 2023→2024 and 2023–24→2025, then reserve 2023–25→2026 as diagnostic-only; report raw and cleaned cohorts separately
slices.verification: Onset process-collapse beats prevalence in every SP/RP fold; return-to-baseline is consistently informative. Persistent and strong-rebound SP sets are small and require clustered intervals. SP result-collapse does not improve in the 2026 diagnostic and is blocked from advancement. Six targets, two cohorts and all fold predictions are persisted; v2 schema/artifact tests passed

slices.label: Slice 14A · Clustered uncertainty and calibration
slices.deliverable: Add pitcher-cluster bootstrap intervals, calibration slope/intercept/ECE and evidence labels for every role-target fold
slices.verification: 100 bootstrap resamples per fold. SP/RP onset process-collapse is supported in all folds; RP return-to-baseline is supported in all folds; 2026 SP return-to-baseline and strong rebound pass the interval screen but remain diagnostic-only. Persistent SP and most strong-rebound cohorts remain ranking-only/uncertain; SP result-collapse remains unsupported

slices.label: Slice 14B · Multiseason advanced refit
slices.deliverable: Fit state-space, HMM regime, GAS+HAR, GJR-GARCH, POT-EVT/CAViaR and forecast challengers on 2023–2025, then run one fixed 2026 diagnostic
slices.verification: 61,398 target predictions and four advanced state artifacts generated. Stuff state improves 2026 RMSE SP 18.03%/RP 11.81%; result state has 0% incremental gain. GJR gamma is 0 for both roles; GAS/GJR gains over EWMA are small. RP CAViaR passes Kupiec (p=.720), EVT supported rates are SP 65.21%/RP 69.16%; only SP/RP process-collapse and RP result/rebound forecast gates pass. 2027 untouched and all outputs research-only

slices.label: Slice 15 · 2027 prospective shadow readiness
slices.deliverable: Freeze Slice 14 fingerprints, lock thresholds/calibration, detect untouched 2027 source availability and prepare append-only prospective monitoring
slices.verification: Readiness artifact generated with model_refit_allowed=false, thresholds/calibration locked, source status awaiting_untouched_2027_source, zero prediction/observation rows and integration gate CLOSED; frozen-input drift detection, API schema and 2 readiness tests passed

slices.label: Slice 16 · Non-destructive model optimization challenger
slices.deliverable: Repair the release gate so prevalence-only predictions cannot pass; select stable EWMA/MA5 or workload/context features on 2025, refit on 2023–2025, and run a fixed 2026 diagnostic with pitcher-cluster uncertainty
slices.verification: performance_state_v2_slice16.json and 81,092-row diagnostic predictions generated; 2023–2024 development, 2025 selection, 2026 diagnostic; baseline-only rejection and API schema tests passed. Same-denominator comparison says keep Slice 14 frozen for all comparable targets except SP strong_rebound, which is only a diagnostic challenger; Slice 14/15 and production integration remain unchanged

slices.label: Slice 17 · Temporal calibration challenger
slices.deliverable: Compare raw, Platt and isotonic calibration on the 2025 selection window, apply the selected calibration to the 2023–2025 refit, and retain calibration only when fixed 2026 Brier and log-loss are not worse
slices.verification: performance_state_v2_slice17.json and 81,092-row diagnostic predictions generated; calibration candidates are temporally selected, most targets retain raw probabilities on 2026, SP return-to-baseline and RP persistent-collapse are calibration-positive diagnostics; Slice 14/15 and production integration remain unchanged; 2 Slice17 tests passed

slices.label: Slice 18 · Empirical-Bayes partial pooling challenger
slices.deliverable: Estimate pitcher-role residual shifts with shrinkage toward the role-global model, select global-only versus partial-pooling on 2025, and evaluate once on fixed 2026
slices.verification: Slice18 section generated with 81,092 predictions; SP strong-rebound selected partial pooling while other role-targets retained global-only; approximation and no-production warnings persisted

slices.label: Slice 19 · Workload selection-bias sensitivity
slices.deliverable: Compare standard workload/context features with pitcher-history residualized workload features without claiming causal identification
slices.verification: Slice19 section generated with 81,092 predictions; only RP persistent-collapse selected residualized workload on 2025, while other targets retained context workload; causal interpretation explicitly blocked

slices.label: Slice 20 · Role and arsenal subgroup calibration
slices.deliverable: Audit calibration by SP/RP, target and dominant Fastball/Breaking/Offspeed arsenal with sparse-group monitoring flags
slices.verification: Slice20 subgroup audit generated for all role-target combinations; small and ECE>0.05 groups marked monitor; no automatic probability retuning; schema/API tests passed

slices.label: Slice 21 · Rolling-origin robustness
slices.deliverable: Run strict 2023→2024, 2023–24→2025 and 2023–25→2026 forward folds for global, partial-pooling and residualized-workload challengers
slices.verification: All eight SP/RP target panels were evaluated with forward-only folds; each challenger reports per-fold AP, Brier, log-loss and non-worse flags; the 2026 fold remains diagnostic-only

slices.label: Slice 22 · Research-only freeze decision
slices.deliverable: Turn rolling-origin evidence into explicit keep-Slice14 versus retain-research-challenger decisions without replacing the formal model
slices.verification: SP persistent-collapse residualized-workload and RP return-to-baseline partial-pooling meet the two-fold research consistency rule; all other targets keep Slice14; formal_model_replaced=false and production gate CLOSED

slices.label: Slice 23 · Strict 2026 replay lock
slices.deliverable: Freeze the role-target layer map, 2023–2024 training, 2025 Platt calibration and false-alert policy before scoring 2026 once
slices.verification: Strict replay fingerprint bd7b04755f1d4de5608814b2c225feabf24d0fe65e547d99b2f8ce8830716a19 generated with 81,092 eligible predictions; model fit/calibration completes before the 2026 state files are loaded; rebound cohorts use the same target eligibility as Slice14; artifact explicitly says retrospective_holdout_replay and integration CLOSED

slices.label: Slice 24 · Lab model synchronization
slices.deliverable: Expose Slice 14 role-target primary probabilities in /lab/performance-state with Slice 18/19 shadow deltas, Slice 20 subgroup monitoring and Slice 22 freeze context; preserve v1 player timeline as explicit fallback
slices.verification: New /api/performance-state/v2-lab route and Lab integration verified against frozen artifacts; formal /leaderboards remains unchanged; backend v2-lab tests, UTF-8 check and Nuxt typecheck passed

projects.title: Player Health & Availability Research
